text: Welcome! In this guide, I'll show you how to install the YouTube Niche Filter Chrome extension, and how to start using it on YouTube. Let's go step by step.
say: Welcome! In this guide, I'll show you how to install the YouTube Niche Filter Chrome extension, and how to start using it on YouTube. Let's go step by step.

text: Step 1: add the extension to Chrome.
say: Step one. Add the extension to Chrome.

text: First, open the Google Drive link for the extension. Click the **Download** button at the top right to download youtube-ai-assistant.zip.
say: First, open the Google Drive link for the extension. Click the Download button at the top right, to download youtube A I assistant dot zip.

text: When the download finishes, open it in your Downloads folder.
say: When the download finishes, open it in your Downloads folder.

text: Chrome can't load a zip file directly, so we unzip it first. Right-click the zip file and choose **Extract All**.
say: Chrome can't load a zip file directly, so we unzip it first. Right-click the zip file, and choose, Extract All.

text: Keep the suggested location and click **Extract**.
say: Keep the suggested location, and click Extract.

text: The new youtube-ai-assistant folder opens. Inside it there's another folder with the same name. Open it, and you'll see **manifest.json**. This is the extension folder we need.
say: The new youtube A I assistant folder opens. Inside it, there's another folder with the same name. Open it, and you'll see manifest dot jason. This is the extension folder we need.

text: Now go back to Chrome. Click the **three-dot menu** in the top right corner, go to **Extensions**, and click **Manage Extensions**.
say: Now go back to Chrome. Click the three dot menu in the top right corner, go to Extensions, and click, Manage Extensions.

text: Tip: you can also open this page by typing **chrome://extensions** in the address bar.
say: Tip: you can also open this page by typing, chrome colon slash slash extensions, in the address bar.

text: In the top right corner of this page, turn on **Developer mode**.
say: In the top right corner of this page, turn on Developer mode.

text: Three new buttons appear on the left: **Load unpacked**, **Pack extension**, and **Update**.
say: Three new buttons appear on the left: Load unpacked, Pack extension, and Update.

text: Click **Load unpacked**.
say: Click, Load unpacked.

text: In the window that opens, go to your **Downloads** folder and open the youtube-ai-assistant folder.
say: In the window that opens, go to your Downloads folder, and open the youtube A I assistant folder.

text: Click once on the inner youtube-ai-assistant folder, the one that contains **manifest.json**, and click **Select Folder**.
say: Click once on the inner youtube A I assistant folder, the one that contains manifest dot jason, and click, Select Folder.

text: Done! YouTube Niche Filter now appears in your extensions. Make sure its switch at the bottom right of the card is turned on.
say: Done! YouTube Niche Filter now appears in your extensions. Make sure its switch, at the bottom right of the card, is turned on.

text: Step 2: open YouTube.
say: Step two. Open YouTube.

text: Open a new tab, type **youtube.com** and press **Enter**. Stay on the YouTube home page, because that's the feed the extension works with.
say: Open a new tab, type youtube dot com, and press Enter. Stay on the YouTube home page, because that's the feed the extension works with.

text: Step 3: select the extension.
say: Step three. Select the extension.

text: Click the **puzzle-piece** Extensions icon in Chrome's toolbar. You'll see YouTube Niche Filter in the list.
say: Click the puzzle piece Extensions icon in Chrome's toolbar. You'll see YouTube Niche Filter in the list.

text: Click the **pin** icon next to it, so the extension always stays visible in your toolbar.
say: Click the pin icon next to it, so the extension always stays visible in your toolbar.

text: Step 4: open the extension.
say: Step four. Open the extension.

text: Click the extension's icon in the toolbar. The Niche Filter panel opens.
say: Click the extension's icon in the toolbar. The Niche Filter panel opens.

text: Check the status cards at the top: Tab should say **YouTube ready**, and Automation should say **Armed**.
say: Check the status cards at the top. Tab should say, YouTube ready. And Automation should say, Armed.

text: Step 5: choose a category.
say: Step five. Choose a category.

text: Scroll down to the Category section and click the **Choose a lane** dropdown.
say: Scroll down to the Category section, and click the, Choose a lane, dropdown.

text: You can pick any built-in category: Tech & Programming, Gaming, Finance & Crypto, Fitness & Health, Business, Education, Entertainment, or Music.
say: You can pick any built in category: Tech and Programming, Gaming, Finance and Crypto, Fitness and Health, Business, Education, Entertainment, or Music.

text: For example, let's pick **Gaming**. The button now says **Scan Gaming**.
say: For example, let's pick Gaming. The button now says, Scan Gaming.

text: If your niche isn't listed, you can add a category manually. Open the dropdown again and choose **Add manually…** at the bottom.
say: If your niche isn't listed, you can add a category manually. Open the dropdown again, and choose, Add manually, at the bottom.

text: Type a category name, for example: **Cooking**.
say: Type a category name. For example, Cooking.

text: Keywords are optional. Add a few separated by commas, like recipe, chef, food. If you leave this empty, the extension creates keywords for you.
say: Keywords are optional. Add a few, separated by commas, like recipe, chef, food. If you leave this empty, the extension creates keywords for you.

text: Click **Add Category**. Your new category is added to the list and selected automatically.
say: Click, Add Category. Your new category is added to the list, and selected automatically.

text: Then click **Save Setup**, so the extension remembers your category.
say: Then click, Save Setup, so the extension remembers your category.

text: Step 6: start it up.
say: Step six. Start it up.

text: Click the **Scan** button to start.
say: Click the Scan button to start.

text: Scroll down to the status message. If it says “Please refresh the YouTube page first”, don't worry: the extension just isn't connected to this tab yet.
say: Scroll down to the status message. If it says, Please refresh the YouTube page first, don't worry. The extension just isn't connected to this tab yet.

text: Click Chrome's **reload** button, or press **F5**, to refresh the YouTube page.
say: Click Chrome's reload button, or press F five, to refresh the YouTube page.

text: When YouTube has loaded, open the extension again. Your saved category is still selected, so just click **Scan** one more time.
say: When YouTube has loaded, open the extension again. Your saved category is still selected, so just click Scan, one more time.

text: Now it's running! The extension analyzes your home feed and opens a video that matches your category. You can follow every step in the **Activity Log**.
say: Now it's running! The extension analyzes your home feed, and opens a video that matches your category. You can follow every step in the Activity Log.

text: It keeps going on its own: it watches matching videos, returns to the home feed and picks the next one. The timers show what happens next.
say: It keeps going on its own. It watches matching videos, returns to the home feed, and picks the next one. The timers show what happens next.

text: To stop it at any time, click the red **STOP** button at the top of the panel.
say: To stop it at any time, click the red STOP button, at the top of the panel.

text: That's it! Unzip the extension, load it with Developer mode, open YouTube, pin and open the extension, choose or add a category, and click Scan. If it asks you to refresh, refresh the page and click Scan again. Happy watching!
say: And that's it! Unzip the extension, load it with Developer mode, open YouTube, pin and open the extension, choose or add a category, and click Scan. If it asks you to refresh, refresh the page, and click Scan again. Happy watching!
